apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

This build brings everything since 0.1.625: a round of fixes from the logs you sent with Send Log and Report a problem and from Discord reports, and a few new switches.

## New

- **Cutscene videos in Unity games:** Unity's video player asks for an RGB picture, and BCD had no converter for it, so cutscenes stayed black (Hollow Knight: Silksong, Hollow Knight, Power Drill Massacre and other Unity games). BCD now has one. It is on in the recommended settings of Silksong, Hollow Knight and Power Drill Massacre; for another Unity game with black cutscenes, add `env.MADEIRA_WG_64BIT = 1`, `env.MADEIRA_OPTIN_DLLS = msvproc` and `env.MADEIRA_WG_VPROC = 1` to its config (Auto-tune says so after such a session).
- **The real refresh rate (experimental):** BCD tells Windows programs that the display runs at 60 Hz, also when a ProMotion device runs a game at 120 Hz. `env.MADEIRA_REPORT_HZ = 1` in a game's config reports the rate the session really holds (120 Hz with the frame limit on MAX, Unlimited or 40 FPS; 60 Hz with the 60 and 30 FPS limits), for games that pace themselves by the monitor's rate. Off by default; not tried on a device yet.
- **Foldable iPhone (experimental):** on the foldable iPhone only, **Settings › Graphics › Foldable iPhone support (experimental)** adapts BCD to the inner display: a new game's default resolution follows its shape, a narrow window gets the phone layout, and the touch controls follow a fold. Off by default; every other iPhone and iPad is unchanged.

## Messages and hints

Text only; none of these changes a setting.

- **Steam games started without Steam:** a Steam copy started with "Start with: The game's own program" that finds no Steam client now says to set Start with to BCD Dock.
- **Missing OpenAL** (DiRT 3, Hotline Miami): Auto-tune says to install it from the Start menu (**BCD Runtimes › OpenAL**).
- **Intro movies BCD cannot play yet** (MPEG-1 and Windows Media video: the classic GTA games, Resident Evil 6, Bully, Warcraft III): the game waits on such a movie, and the message says to press a key to skip each one, or to rename the movie files (for the classic GTA games `movies\Logo.mpg` and `movies\GTAtitles.mpg`).
- **Copied game folders:** a DLL that is an empty or damaged file in the copy (often a folder copied while iCloud Drive was still downloading) is named, with what to do.
- **Browsers and web launchers:** a Chromium program that keeps its `chrome_elf.dll` in its version folder, and one that asks for 64 GB of address space in one piece, are named as known stops.
- **A game's own "Steam is not running" box** (Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered through BCD Dock) is named, as are its log lines.
- **32-bit games on an install without extended virtual addressing:** when the address map is too small for a 32-bit program's 4 GB window, the message says which install method gives the room.

## Fixes and improvements

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

Each fix targets the error a log showed; most could not be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem. "Known stop" means Auto-tune now names the stop and stops trying, instead of spending starts on settings that cannot help.

### Games

- **Batman: Arkham City GOTY:** after about a minute of play, a tessellation shader too large for the GPU's mesh limit was drawn without its pipeline and the graphics driver stopped the game. Such draws are now skipped. Its one-time installs also no longer run the DirectX setup and the AMD Dual-Core Optimizer setup, which failed or never closed at the first start.
- **BioShock Remastered (Epic):** its start through BCD Host and the 32-bit game's graphics handle table, in new recommended settings.
- **Burnout Paradise: The Ultimate Box:** its "CPU Error / This machine does not support the SSE2 Command Set" box came from a processor flag BCD's x86 translator reported as missing. `env.MADEIRA_FEX_CPUID_CLASSIC = 1` reports it like a real processor; new recommended settings and Auto-tune give it.
- **Call of Duty: Black Ops, Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition, Fallout: New Vegas, Saints Row: The Third, Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition:** the DirectX setup of the first start failed, and the game started only after BCD was restarted. BCD ships what that setup installs, so their recommended settings now mark it as done (`env.MADEIRA_DOCK_INSTALL_SKIP = directx`) and the first Play starts the game.
- **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009):** its DirectDraw part needs OpenGL; its recommended settings and Auto-tune give Wine's Direct3D an adapter without 3D (`env.WINE_D3D_CONFIG = renderer=no3d`).
- **Clair Obscur: Expedition 33:** the render thread stopped at the first scene frame: Metal placed some of the game's GPU memory blocks off the boundary Direct3D 12 promises, so Unreal Engine could not fit a 128 MB buffer. `d3d12-heap-va-align = 1` (in its recommended settings and from Auto-tune) starts such blocks on the boundary. The recommended settings also start the game at 30 FPS with the tip to lower its graphics.
- **CrossCode:** its 32-bit renderer crashed in the same one-time initialisation as Control; new recommended settings give the same fix.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** its 64 GB and 32 GB memory reservations were refused; its recommended settings and Auto-tune let BCD reserve half (an experiment).
- **Dead Island Definitive Edition and Dead Island Riptide Definitive Edition:** Dying Light's settings (the English locale and Wine's `setupapi.dll` and `ddraw.dll`) for the same engine.
- **Deadlock:** the split JIT pool instead of running without a pool copy, which stopped after about 110 frames.
- **Football Manager 27:** its simulation library needs `tbs.dll`; new recommended settings give it, with the library out of the JIT pool from the first start.
- **GHPC:** new recommended settings: 30 FPS, the graphics tip and, on devices under 10 GB, the swap file from the first start.
- **GTA IV (Steam):** Rockstar's launcher was told its connection to the update service was ready before it was, so its first message failed and it said the service was unavailable. `env.MADEIRA_SRV_POLLOUT_GUARD = 1` (in its recommended settings and from Auto-tune) waits for the real connection. The recommended settings also put the launcher's whole log into BCD's log.
- **GTA V Enhanced on devices under 10 GB:** iOS closed the game at the memory limit; its recommended settings now use the larger swap file there.
- **Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice** ("black screen with sound"): its recommended settings log how bright the presented frames are.
- **Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth:** its start-up check said the processor lacks AVX; Auto-tune now reports AVX to it.
- **Murder Miners:** a 5 ms audio buffer against choppy sound.
- **Mycopunk:** when iOS closes the game while its compressed textures fill the memory, Auto-tune drops the largest level of each texture (`dxmt = d3d11.mipClampBC=1`).
- **NieR:Automata:** when the program ended by itself (it found no Steam), BCD's own exit report crashed reading a library that was already unloaded and turned the clean exit into a crash. The report now reads such memory safely, and the "looked for Steam" message shows.
- **Nioh 2:** the game waited for ever for a resolution preset that fits BCD's screen; its recommended settings use 1366x768, and Auto-tune says to set it.
- **Overcooked! 2 and Power Drill Massacre:** 32-bit Unity games whose code writes slowed them to a crawl; their recommended settings make that memory plain.
- **Oxygen Not Included:** the same Auto-tune line as Mycopunk, and on devices under 10 GB its recommended settings clamp the largest texture levels when memory runs low.
- **Poppy Playtime:** its launcher, running without a copy in BCD's code memory, read a Windows library's data (`std::cout`) from the wrong place and crashed. `env.MADEIRA_X64_NOCOPY_DATAIMP = 1` gives it the right one; new recommended settings and Auto-tune.
- **Red Dead Redemption:** its stop in `MTLX.dll` is named as a known stop, and the next log shows the instruction bytes.
- **Risk of Rain 2 and Valheim:** the fix for Unity games that write into their own code memory (`env.MADEIRA_MZ_VIEW_CHECK = 1`) in their recommended settings.
- **Rockstar games through BCD Dock** (Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA V, GTA V Enhanced, GTA IV): after you press Close, the session now ends when the game ends. Rockstar's launcher stays resident, which 0.1.625 waited for.
- **Sable:** the app closed when the controller's rumble engine threw an error; BCD now drops that engine and the game goes on.
- **Slay the Spire 2 through BCD Dock:** the black window: the game got Wine's own `dcomp.dll` instead of BCD's. Fixed.
- **Spelunky 2:** its audio library asked again and again for memory at addresses beyond what BCD gives a program, and the game never drew. `env.MADEIRA_HINT_STORM_N = 4096` (in its recommended settings and from Auto-tune) serves such a request elsewhere after 4,096 refusals in a row.
- **Splatterhouse:** the program looks for a large block of memory at exact addresses that are not free on these devices; BCD now refuses the one it answered wrongly before (the program wrote into nothing), and Auto-tune says the program cannot start here.
- **Tomb Raider: Game of the Year Edition:** crashed in its first seconds when BCD read the header of a library the game had already unloaded. Fixed.
- **Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2:** the game asks for a thread's state without giving a place to store it; Windows answers that the pointer is invalid, BCD's system library crashed on it. BCD now answers like Windows.
- **The app no longer freezes after certain game crashes:** BCD's own exception handler could fault while it described a crash, and then nothing answered the next one (Poppy Playtime, Garry's Mod, Mycopunk, FINAL FANTASY TACTICS, Kerbal Space Program and others).
- **Known stops** (named, no setting helps yet): Balatro (its Lua engine needs memory below 2 GB, and it draws with OpenGL), Jetboard Joust, Stardew Valley and Fields of Mistria (OpenGL), Sleeping Dogs (2012, a jump to an invalid address at start), Golf With Your Friends on installs without the memory entitlements.
- **Diagnostics only** (the next log names the cause): Caravan SandWitch, Dragon Age: Origins, Haak, Reskate.

### Launchers and stores

- **EA app:** for Steam games from EA started through BCD Dock (Mass Effect Legendary Edition, The Sims 4), the EA app's installer stopped with error 1923 because Windows Installer could not start; its install session now gets it.
- **Epic:** Auto-tune gives the BCD Host start (`env.BCD_EPIC_HOST_START = 1`) also after the Epic Store's error box (BioShock Remastered).
- **Rockstar:** the Close fix and the GTA IV connection fix above; plain messages when the installer is closed, when the launcher's update service cannot be reached, when a game is started without Steam's client, and when a game's own config blocks the launcher (`env.MADEIRA_SPAWN_BLOCK`). The installer's "Failed to open handle to SCM!" is recognised as the service manager problem 0.1.624 fixed.

### Auto-tune

- **How it judges a start:** a box titled "Error Log" is not an error box (Dragon Age: Origins' settings program); the Wine server's fatal error counts as a failure; a plug-in that cannot load followed by exit code 1 counts as a crash; a session iOS closed at its peak memory counts as a memory close even when the last line is a little lower; Metal's assertion followed by the abort counts as a crash.
- **What it can change:** when the split JIT pool's second part lands away from its planned place, Auto-tune lets BCD ask for it again (`pool-split-retry = 1`; GTA IV, GTA V, Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition).
- **What it says:** many new rules from your logs, with fixes or known-stop messages (listed per game above). A fault inside BCD's x86 translator while a process is already ending no longer takes the verdict.

### Logs

New log lines so that the next log names a cause: the display rate a game was granted and the rate Windows programs are told, the GPU address of a Direct3D 12 game's transient memory blocks, the kernel's regions behind a refused large memory view, BCD's answer to a NULL thread context, served memory requests (Spelunky 2), withheld network events (GTA IV), data imports of programs without a code copy, the video converter's pictures, the processor flags BCD reports, and the draws skipped for a pipeline that did not compile.

### Under the hood

- BCD's x86 translator no longer faults on an exception that arrives after a process's translator was torn down (it passes the exception on, as for any address outside its code).
- New host checks for every change of this build; the build refuses an IPA without the skipped-draw fix in the 64-bit `d3d11.dll`.
- Wine's video processor (`msvproc`) for 64-bit games is built from source in the build.

**Known issues:**
- Frame generation with MetalFX upscaling can make the graphics driver stop the game after a minute or two. Turn Frame generation off for now.
- GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 from Steam: the Rockstar Launcher sometimes says Steam is not running (error 113, "please reinstall") although it is. It comes and goes; fully close BCD and start the game again. If it keeps happening, send the game's log with **Report a problem** on its page.

Install help, game reports and ideas: join the [BCD-Games Discord](https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug).

**BCD.ipa**: the unsigned IPA, for sideloading with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. It needs iOS 18 or later and JIT; the README has the details.
**BCD-source.tar.xz**: the complete source of this build with all its submodules (GPL-3.0).
